name: Elk River Floats & Wayside Campground
description: Elk River Floats location at Wayside in Noel, with riverside tent and RV camping. Cabins and vacation rentals are offsite.

name: Kozy Kamp (Elk River Floats)
description: Pineville campground with primitive and electric tent sites, RV hookups and camping huts. Cabins and vacation rentals are offsite.

name: Eagles Nest Camp & Canoe
description: Elk River Floats family campground in the Noel area with tent camping and RV hookup sites.

name: River Ranch Resort
description: Noel outfitter with tent and RV camping, cabins and glamping. Sycamore Landing is its separate nearby campground.

name: Shady Beach Campground
description: Noel campground and outfitter with tent and RV camping, cabins, boat rentals and shuttles.
seasonal_notes: A float booking is required to camp from Memorial Day through Labor Day.

name: Big Elk Floats and Camping
description: Pineville outfitter on the south side of the Elk River bridge, offering boat rentals, tent camping and cabins.
seasonal_notes: Camping is offered March through October; offseason hours vary.

name: Trestle Park / Elk River Campground
description: Elk River campground in Ginger Blue with primitive and electric tent sites, RV sites, cabins and showers. Private river-access passes are offered.
alt_names: Elk River Campground|Elk River Floats & Trestle Park

name: Sycamore Landing (River Ranch Resort)
description: River Ranch Resort campground on an island near the main Noel property, with tent camping, an RV area, restrooms and showers.

name: The Spot / Lower Elk River Adventures
description: Lower Elk campground offering tent and full-hookup RV camping, cabins, canoe and kayak rentals, personal-boat shuttles and paid launch access.
seasonal_notes: Open year-round; contact the campground for reservations.
alt_names: Lower Elk River Adventures|The Spot on Elk River
